dct_description_sm: Cameroon administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 10 Region (Région) - Admin 2: 58 Department (Département) - Admin 3: 360 Arrondissement Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 04 January 2019: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 22 August 1987: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 22 August 1987: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Cameroon](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-cameroon). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
